# Whale Isle 0.3.13

- **Update center**: The launcher, Settings and the tray share one update overlay. New versions download and verify in the background, then install and restart in one click; background downloading can be turned off in the update center.
- **Smaller downloads**: The cheaper of an incremental or full download is picked automatically, falling back to the full download if the incremental one fails. Downloads resume after pausing, a dropped connection or a restart.
- **Draft images are kept**: Unsent images in the composer survive switching pages.
- **Safer closing of unsaved files**: Autosave pauses before you choose; a failed save keeps the draft and shows the full error in the dialog.
- **macOS**: Native menus and a Dock menu, Command and Control told apart, and ⌘ shortcuts no longer go into the terminal.
- **GitHub rate limits**: The error says when access recovers and suggests a token or the CNB route.

Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon installers are provided (the Mac package is unsigned; right-click and choose Open the first time). Updating from 0.3.12 still uses the old flow; later updates go through the update center. Android, WhaleBridge and the ChatGPT plugin are released separately.
